world: a sunken temple under misty sea water, pale stone columns and stairs, flooded halls with rippling reflections, drifting fog and cool blue-green light

b-jelly.describe: a translucent misty jellyfish floating in the air, glowing pale blue bell with long trailing tentacles

b-serpent.describe: a great sea serpent dragon with teal and silver scales, long coiling body, fin-like crest and whiskers

b-nagi.describe: a majestic sea goddess sorceress with very long flowing dark blue hair, a crown of coral and pearls, layered white and deep blue robes like waves, holding a tall ornate staff topped with a glowing aqua crystal, serene cold expression
